title: [ES] [ES] German Indirect Speech (Konjunktiv I)
rules: Hauptsatz + , + Subjekt + Konjunktiv I (Ende oder Pos 2)

example_translations.ex_de_b2_2: Er sagt, er habe keine Zeit.

common_error_explanations.err_de_b2_2: In formal indirect speech (reported speech), use Konjunktiv I forms (e.g., habe, sei) to attribute statements neutrally.
